## Drivers

Each driver is standardised to mean 0 and unit standard deviation. Only weather is used in this step; the response does not enter.

```r
make_drivers <- function(wx, drivers = c("TT", "DL", "RAW", "RAD")) {
  years <- sort(unique(wx$year))
  das0 <- min(wx$das)
  nd <- max(wx$das) - das0 + 1
  U <- array(NA_real_, c(length(years), nd, length(drivers)),
             dimnames = list(years, NULL, drivers))
  for (j in seq_along(drivers)) {
    i <- cbind(match(wx$year, years), wx$das - das0 + 1, j)
    U[i] <- wx[[drivers[j]]]
  }
  # seasons end on different days: pad with the last value (never fitted)
  for (y in seq_along(years)) {
    for (j in seq_along(drivers)) {
      u <- U[y, , j]
      U[y, is.na(u), j] <- tail(u[!is.na(u)], 1)
    }
  }
  center <- apply(U, 3, mean)
  scale <- apply(U, 3, function(x) sqrt(mean((x - mean(x))^2)))
  list(U = sweep(sweep(U, 3, center), 3, scale, "/"), years = years,
       das0 = das0, drivers = drivers, center = center, scale = scale)
}
```

## Library

The library contains a constant and the first three powers of each driver, $K = 13$ terms.

```r
library_matrix <- function(Z, degree = 3, pairs = FALSE) {
  term <- function(x, p) if (p == 1) x else paste0(x, "^", p)
  cols <- list(`1` = rep(1, nrow(Z)))
  for (d in colnames(Z)) {
    for (p in 1:degree) cols[[term(d, p)]] <- Z[, d]^p
  }
  if (pairs) {
    for (ij in combn(colnames(Z), 2, simplify = FALSE)) {
      for (p in 1:2) {
        for (q in 1:2) {
          name <- paste0(term(ij[1], p), "*", term(ij[2], q))
          cols[[name]] <- Z[, ij[1]]^p * Z[, ij[2]]^q
        }
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(cbind, cols)
}
```

```r
make_library <- function(drv, degree = 3, pairs = FALSE) {
  d <- dim(drv$U)
  Z <- matrix(drv$U, ncol = d[3], dimnames = list(NULL, drv$drivers))
  L <- library_matrix(Z, degree, pairs)
  array(L, c(d[1:2], ncol(L)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, colnames(L)))
}
```

## Response

The response is stored as an array `Y[genotype, year, day]`, with `NA` after maturity. The number of daily steps of each trajectory is kept in `nend`.

```r
make_trajectories <- function(traj, drv, var = "biomass") {
  gen <- sort(unique(traj$genotype))
  Y <- array(NA_real_, c(length(gen), length(drv$years), dim(drv$U)[2]),
             dimnames = list(gen, drv$years, NULL))
  i <- cbind(match(traj$genotype, gen), match(traj$year, drv$years),
             traj$das - drv$das0 + 1)
  Y[i] <- traj[[var]]
  nend <- apply(Y, c(1, 2), function(v) sum(!is.na(v)) - 1)
  list(Y = Y, nend = nend, genotypes = gen, years = drv$years,
       das0 = drv$das0)
}
```

## Design matrix

The increments $z_t = y_{t+1} - y_t$ are regressed on the library at day $t$. For three genotypes:

```r
build_design <- function(Theta, tr, genotypes = tr$genotypes) {
  idx <- expand.grid(y = seq_along(tr$years),
                     g = match(genotypes, tr$genotypes))
  xz <- Map(function(g, y) trajectory_xz(Theta, tr, g, y), idx$g, idx$y)
  n <- tr$nend[cbind(idx$g, idx$y)]
  X <- do.call(rbind, lapply(xz, `[[`, "X"))
  colnames(X) <- dimnames(Theta)[[3]]
  id <- data.frame(genotype = rep(tr$genotypes[idx$g], n),
                   year = rep(tr$years[idx$y], n),
                   day = sequence(n) - 1)
  list(X = X, z = unlist(lapply(xz, `[[`, "z")), id = id)
}
```

## Normal equations

A linear fit needs only $A = X^\top X$ and $b = X^\top z$. These are computed per genotype and season, avoiding the full design matrix (about 850,000 rows for all genotypes).

```r
gram_stats <- function(Theta, tr) {
  G <- dim(tr$Y)[1]
  ny <- length(tr$years)
  K <- dim(Theta)[3]
  A <- array(0, c(G, ny, K, K))
  b <- array(0, c(G, ny, K))
  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    for (y in seq_len(ny)) {
      s <- trajectory_xz(Theta, tr, g, y)
      A[g, y, , ] <- crossprod(s$X)
      b[g, y, ] <- crossprod(s$X, s$z)
    }
  }
  list(A = A, b = b, n = tr$nend, names = dimnames(Theta)[[3]])
}
```
